deck_context.core_claim: 默认有结构，自定义非必需。系统提供默认结构，管理员可修改或自定义，员工不必先搭建。先做好资料归属、查找、维护与可见范围。

style.name: 清爽专业风·蓝白产品汇报
style.visual_direction: Refined modern Chinese executive product report. White canvas, ink navy headings, cobalt blue emphasis, very pale ice blue surfaces. Open whitespace, precise alignment, large projection-readable Chinese sans-serif type. Follow the sample palette, typography and visual clarity. Vary composition purposefully.
style.color_palette: White #FFFFFF, navy #142B49, cobalt #2563EB, ice blue #EFF5FF; no green, no purple, no warm beige, no neon, no dark full backgrounds.

style.texture_and_finish: Clean flat design. Only simple relevant folder/document/search/permission symbols. No photographs, no 3D glass, no dramatic gradients or heavy shadow. No repeated card-grid template.
style.canvas: 16:9 landscape, 2560x1440 target, full image canvas, 5 percent safe margins. No slide numbers, no logos or watermark.
